setup: CREATE SCHEMA app; CREATE TYPE app.pair AS (id integer,label text); CREATE TYPE app.wrapper AS (item app.pair,items app.pair[]); CREATE TABLE app.t(p app.pair); CREATE TABLE app.u(w app.wrapper); CREATE TABLE app.src(p app.pair); CREATE FUNCTION app.bump(integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql RETURN $1+1; CREATE FUNCTION app.label(text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql RETURN upper($1); CREATE FUNCTION app.doc() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql RETURN '{"x":1,"arr":[1,2]}'::jsonb; CREATE FUNCTION app.number() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql RETURN 1; CREATE TYPE app.intspan AS RANGE(SUBTYPE=integer,MULTIRANGE_TYPE_NAME=app.intspans); CREATE TYPE app.nestedspan AS RANGE(SUBTYPE=int4range); CREATE FUNCTION app.json_pair(jsonb) RETURNS app.pair LANGUAGE sql RETURN ROW(1,'json')::app.pair; CREATE CAST(jsonb AS app.pair) WITH FUNCTION app.json_pair(jsonb);

field_assignment.sql: CREATE FUNCTION app.field_assignment() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC UPDATE app.t SET p.id=app.number(),p.label=app.label('x'); END

nested_assignment.sql: CREATE FUNCTION app.nested_assignment() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC UPDATE app.u SET w.item.label=app.label('x'),w.items[1].id=app.number(); END

ranges.sql: SELECT '[1,2)'::int4range AS c_int4range, '[1,2)'::int8range AS c_int8range, '[1,2)'::numrange AS c_numrange, '[2020-01-01,2020-01-02)'::daterange AS c_daterange, '[2020-01-01,2020-01-02)'::tsrange AS c_tsrange, '[2020-01-01 00:00+00,2020-01-02 00:00+00)'::tstzrange AS c_tstzrange, '{[1,2)}'::int4multirange AS c_int4multirange, '{[1,2)}'::int8multirange AS c_int8multirange, '{[1,2)}'::nummultirange AS c_nummultirange, '{[2020-01-01,2020-01-02)}'::datemultirange AS c_datemultirange, '{[2020-01-01,2020-01-02)}'::tsmultirange AS c_tsmultirange, '{[2020-01-01 00:00+00,2020-01-02 00:00+00)}'::tstzmultirange AS c_tstzmultirange, '[1,2)'::app.intspan AS custom_range, '{[1,2)}'::app.intspans AS custom_multirange, '["[1,2)","[3,4)")'::app.nestedspan AS nested_range, 'empty'::int4range AS empty_range, '(,)'::int4range AS unbounded_range

json_object.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('number' VALUE app.number() RETURNING jsonb) AS value

json_array.sql: SELECT JSON_ARRAY(app.number(),app.doc() RETURNING jsonb) AS value

json_predicate.sql: SELECT app.doc() IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS AS value

json_aggregate.sql: SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(app.label((p).label) RETURNING jsonb) AS value FROM app.t

json_siblings.sql: SELECT * FROM JSON_TABLE(app.doc(), '$' COLUMNS(NESTED PATH '$.arr[*]' COLUMNS(v integer PATH '$'), NESTED PATH '$.arr[*]' COLUMNS(w integer PATH '$'))) AS j

json_value.sql: SELECT JSON_VALUE(app.doc(), '$.missing' RETURNING integer DEFAULT app.number() ON EMPTY) AS value

json_query.sql: SELECT JSON_QUERY(app.doc(), '$.x' RETURNING jsonb WITH WRAPPER) AS value

json_exists.sql: SELECT JSON_EXISTS(app.doc(), '$.x ? (@ > $v)' PASSING app.number() AS v) AS value

json_serialize.sql: SELECT JSON_SERIALIZE(app.doc() RETURNING text) AS value

json_table.sql: SELECT * FROM JSON_TABLE(app.doc(), '$' COLUMNS(n integer PATH '$.x' DEFAULT app.number() ON EMPTY, NESTED PATH '$.arr[*]' COLUMNS(v integer PATH '$'))) AS j

returning_oldnew.sql: CREATE FUNCTION app.returning_oldnew() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC UPDATE app.t SET p.id=2 RETURNING (OLD.p).id; END

merge_action.sql: CREATE FUNCTION app.merge_action() RETURNS SETOF text LANGUAGE sql BEGIN ATOMIC MERGE INTO app.t d USING app.src s ON (d.p).id=(s.p).id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.id=(s.p).id RETURNING merge_action(); END
